opportunities.title: Nuffield Farming Next-Gen Scholarship

amount.raw: The successful applicants will be awarded a Next-Gen Scholarship worth £6,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Young people aged 18-24, open to applicants from the UK with a demonstrable interest in the industry (e.g. dairy, regenerative agriculture).
opportunities.summary: A 30-day fully funded study programme for young people aged 18-24 to develop their understanding of the industry, build networks and future opportunities. Successful applicants spend a month staying on farms with Nuffield Scholars, following an induction day in London. Includes all travel and subsistence, attendance at the Nuffield Conference, Nuffield Farming Associate membership, and a financial incentive of £1,000 to part cover replacement labour cost. In 2027 the Trust plans to award three dairy and three pig scholarships.
